description: This file declares the interface for reflog walking functionality, including initialization, releasing resources, adding entries, generating messages, and retrieving reflog information.

methods.name: reflog_walk_info_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with reflog walk info.

methods.name: add_reflog_for_walk
methods.description: Adds a commit entry to the reflog walk.

methods.name: show_reflog_message
methods.description: Displays a reflog message based on walk info and date mode.

methods.name: get_reflog_message
methods.description: Retrieves the reflog message into a string buffer.

methods.name: get_reflog_ident
methods.description: Returns the identification string of the reflog entry.

methods.name: get_reflog_timestamp
methods.description: Gets the timestamp of the reflog entry.

methods.name: get_reflog_selector
methods.description: Generates a selector string for reflog entries.

methods.name: reflog_walk_empty
methods.description: Checks if the reflog walk is empty.

methods.name: next_reflog_entry
methods.description: Returns the next reflog commit entry.
